messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The reports pipeline is not a Boreal service. [valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-06]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-15]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- Team Atlas pinged the owners of billing-api on 2025-12-31. [valid 2025-12-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-31]
- The flags service is Team Atlas's service as of 2026-04-21, after moving from Team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is Team Dune's service as of 2026-01-29, after moving from Cinder. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to 2026-04-21; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-18 to 2026-01-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- Billing-api is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-03-25, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-03-25 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-25-billing-api]
    earlier: Billing-api is owned by Boreal as of 2025-12-24, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-24 to 2026-03-25; recorded by handover/2025-12-24-billing-api]
    earlier: Team Atlas owns billing-api as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-24; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28. [decision; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer]
    earlier: Cinder owns the indexer as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-02-28; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- The webhooks service belongs to Team Atlas as of 2025-09-09, after Ember handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service belongs to team Ember as of 2025-04-11. [decision; valid 2025-04-11 to 2025-09-09; recorded by handover/2025-04-11-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service is a Boreal service as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]

Question: Which team owns the service that reporting depends on?
